accepted.definition: feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
accepted.simpleMeaning: Feeling or showing sorrow, regret, or a sense of loss over something you did or failed to do.
accepted.scope: This is not a judgment that someone has an evil character or that food is unfit to eat; it describes sorrow about an action or a failure to act.
examples: I feel bad about breaking your cup.
She felt bad for not visiting him sooner.

accepted.definition: characterized by wickedness or immorality
accepted.simpleMeaning: Showing cruel or otherwise morally wrong character or behavior.
accepted.scope: This is not feeling sorry about something done, having poor skill, or food becoming unfit to eat; it describes moral wrongdoing.
examples: He was a bad man who took pleasure in hurting others.
Her bad deeds harmed people who trusted her.

accepted.definition: (of foodstuffs) not in an edible or usable condition
accepted.simpleMeaning: In a condition that makes food unfit to eat or use.
accepted.scope: This is not describing an evil person or someone who feels sorry; it describes food that can no longer be eaten or used.
examples: The milk has gone bad, so throw it out.
We found bad eggs at the back of the fridge.
